source_notes.label: Two quantified material routes
source_notes.summary: AgCl, elemental Ga or In, and sulfur are treated with ethylenediamine in a 50 mL autoclave filled to 85%, within 180–230 °C for 10 h. The reported metal charges differ: Ga 0.648 g or In 1.068 g. The source does not assign the exact temperature of either Figure 1/2 sample.
source_locators: Main PDF p. 1, Typical procedure and Figure 1

source_notes.label: Solvent coordination is a source interpretation
source_notes.summary: The authors propose that basic, bidentate ethylenediamine forms a relatively stable Ag+ complex, incorporates dissolved sulfur and permits a liquid–solution diffusion process as Ga melts. Pyridine yields incomplete reaction and lower purity under otherwise constant conditions. Benzene yields mostly unreacted AgCl and Ga and no AgGaS2 by XRD. These comparisons are AgGaS2-specific and are not assigned to AgInS2.

source_notes.label: Separate crystallite and particle sizes
source_notes.summary: Scherrer estimates are 6 nm for AgGaS2 and 10 nm for AgInS2. TEM diameter ranges are 5–7 and 9–12 nm, respectively. Figure 2 caption links its specimens to Figure 1. Image scale bars are preserved but are not substituted for particle sizes.
source_locators: Main PDF p. 1–2, XRD/Scherrer and TEM discussion; Figures 1–2

source_notes.label: Comparisons are not invented discrete trials
source_notes.summary: For AgGaS2, below 150 °C OR shorter than 5 h gives lower crystallinity; above 250 °C OR longer than 12 h gives larger particles and solvent-carbonization contamination. Exact tested values, paired time/temperature and numerical sizes are not given. The four inequality statements are separate supporting observations, not combined conditions.
source_locators: Main PDF p. 2, Temperature and time comparisons

source_notes.label: Analytical limits and future extensions
source_notes.summary: XPS detects no obvious chloride or elemental sulfur impurities at a stated 1 at% resolution limit; this is an analytical limit, not a measured impurity value. The Ag:Ga:S ratio 1:1.08:2.10 belongs only to AgGaS2. Proposed extension to AgMSe2 and CuMS2 (M=Ga, In) is an outlook, not an achieved additional synthesis. Background optical properties and high-temperature solid-state routes belong to cited literature.
source_locators: Main PDF p. 1–2, XPS, introduction and conclusion
